The RBI grants a 30-day grace period for all accounts

Regulators usually implement these, in part, to align with international Basel III norms regarding credit discipline.

Because bank dividends will be capped at 120 bps

Misalignment between energy subsidies and water conservation

Irrigation methods are largely virtual and unproven
Water is imported to manufacture local goods
India exports crops that require massive water volumes
